nodes.label: Evidence clerk model
nodes.rationale: Must have built-in web search so source links are provider citations, never model-written URLs; personas only cite pages actually retrieved.

nodes.label: Document fetch with SSRF protection
nodes.rationale: Only public http(s) addresses accepted; private IPs, odd ports, credentials refused; redirects re-checked; size and time capped.

nodes.label: Multiple API keys and rotation
nodes.rationale: Round robin across keys spreads load over separate rate limits; failed keys are parked so others continue.

nodes.label: Step 3: Anonymous peer review
nodes.rationale: Anonymized, shuffled responses keep review unbiased; rankings mapped back server-side and averaged.

nodes.label: Vercel Services deployment
nodes.rationale: Async steps return 202 and run via waitUntil so each step has its own time budget.
